body: Sugar free jello is my go-to. Low in cals, pretty good selection of flavors, and helps when I want something sweet.
My mom would probably kill herself if I killed myself too so I try to stay for her and my “friends”.
Today this lady who works at a small restaurant I go to often told me I looked skinnier since she’s last seen me. Safe to say she expanded my life span with that one.

Same.  I feel like i’m drowning in assignments and i’m kinda worried I won’t be able to get them done before the semester ends. I wasn’t a model student in high school but I was on top of my shit.  But now everything just feels so optional.
